wholePhysicalScope: The named church way provides the northwest front and full 12-point envelope of the church and attached rear wings. The curved nave, towers and stair and balcony profiles follow written accounts. A separate native way identifies the cemetery.
lodDetails: Each level retains the twin belfries, Rococo pediment and cross, curved terracotta-roofed nave, attached rear wings and entrance terrace. Street and closeup add stone balusters, cutout bell arches and carved portal detail.
limitations: Standing exterior reconstruction. Tower diameters and roof sections, individual stone carvings and window finish are approximate.
The church envelope is mapped. Its curving sides and the later steps and forecourt are reconstructed from published architectural descriptions.
The original terrain establishes local relief, with approximate floor and forecourt contact. The cemetery remains outside the model scope.
